o1: This course should take a high priority in your day as it is geared to help you grasp a firmer hold on God's Word and to deepen your understanding of His will for your life.
o2: Each session two new Scriptures should be memorized for a written or verbal quiz at the beginning of each class.
o3: Each study's content and the order of Scriptures should also be memorized for the quiz.
o4: Each student is required to memorize the names of all the books of the Bible.
o5: Read Ron Harding's The Untold Story: Chronicles Of Modern-Day Christianity by Session 8.
o6: An outline of the Book of Acts will be turned in by session 11. Each student is required to memorize two points from each chapter in the Book of Acts.
session8BaptismHS: The Baptism With The Holy Spirit
session9MGHS: The Miraculous Gifts Of The Holy Spirit
suggestedRLP1: These books are recommended as thought-provoking and informative tools to be used in gaining insights into God's Word. Some of the books are not Biblically correct on all doctrinal points.
bookElevate: Elevate — Jesus' Global Revolution For Women
bookBattleKingsLost: A Battle That Even Kings Lost
bookProvenGenuine: Proven Genuine — An Examination Of Suffering In The Book Of Job
scriptureMemP1: “But in your hearts set apart Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect.” 1 Peter 3:15
